title: dpia_report
description: Output contract of the dpia agent (requirement b: InfoSec TPA Report for the DPO team). Rendered to DOCX by functions/delivery/renderers/dpia/render.py — the python-docx port of the byte-verified Node generator (claude-account-export/skills/dpia/scripts/generate_report.js), layout reproduced 1:1 and driven entirely by this contract. Status and RAG vocabularies are fixed because they select the cell shading (Implemented C6EFCE / Pending FFEB9C / Not Doing FFC7CE).

assessment.description: OneTrust assessment name/id the report is derived from.

dateRange.description: Assessment window as printed in the supplier table, e.g. '01/05/2026 - 20/05/2026'.

doraScope.description: DORA scope statement, e.g. 'In scope - ICT service supporting a critical or important function'.

certifications.description: Free text as printed in the supplier table, e.g. 'ISO 27001 - valid, in scope'.

inherentRisk.description: '<score>-<band>', e.g. '12-Medium' — the score/band pair printed in the register.

responsible.description: Owning party (Euronext team or the supplier) — role names or placeholder UPNs only.

implementedDomains.description: Domains rendered bold in the conclusion paragraph.

approval.description: '<Analyst> (Analyst) - Approved | <Manager> (Manager) - Approved'; the four-eyes record from team/approval-policy.json, not a free-text claim.

dueDate.description: DD/MM/YYYY; defaults to today + 2 months as in the source generator.

rag.description: Score/label pair; the label selects the cell shading (LOW green, MEDIUM amber, HIGH red).
